title: Black Giant Legion owners get the new combined head free
summary:
Mecha Invasion’s official Weibo post about the improved combined-mode head (shared to the TFW2005 Giant Legion thread) adds a detail the earlier WeChat recap didn’t carry: the black limited Giant Legion set, which the studio says has already shipped, will get the new head as a free replacement part. Mecha Invasion says it will contact the sellers to arrange it.

The same post repeats that the redesigned head answers fan complaints about the small combined head and will ship with the Set D accessory pack (GLA-07). Two new gray-prototype photos of the head came with it.

No replacement timing, process, or shipping cost was stated. A fan on the thread guesses buyers may need to cover shipping, but that isn’t official. Check with the store you ordered from.

title: Giant Legion Set D gets an improved combined head
summary:
Mecha Invasion posted a gray prototype of a new combined-mode helmet/head for the Giant Legion accessory pack on its official WeChat on 20 October 2026. Their note: taking fans’ opinions into account, the designers worked overnight on the accessory-pack combiner helmet, the small head people complained about has been improved, and it will be included in the Set D accessory pack (GLA-07) and ship with it.

The photo was shared to the TFW2005 Giant Legion thread (page 165). No new price or ship date came with it; GLA-07 stays listed as preorder here.

title: Titan Empyrean TE01B 垒戍 (Brawl-style tank) preorders open
summary:
Mecha Invasion’s official Weibo opened preorders for the second Titan Empyrean (泰坦星寰) member on 14 October 2026: TE01B 垒戍, a realistic main battle tank that transforms into a robot and also forms the left leg of the 参伐战神 combiner (the Bruticus-style TE01).

Official specs: 25 cm robot to top of head, about 55 cm combined; ABS, POM, alloy and soft PVC; damped, gear and alloy joints; magnetic eye and vehicle lights and a magnetic weapon grip. Each unit includes a 1:6 heavy machine gun with modular parts and an effects display base. Shipping is planned for Q1 2027 and the price is still to be announced. Sixteen official gray prototype photos (robot, gun and tank modes) are now in the catalog.

In official Weibo replies on 15 October, Mecha Invasion said the combined image was held back from the trade show because of last-minute changes, and that an updated image is expected around the end of the month. They also replied 「袭击快来了」 ("the attack is coming soon"), which fans on TFW2005 read as an Onslaught hint; that is not a confirmed name.

title: Giant Legion clear set ETA + black finished product photo
summary:
Mecha Invasion’s official Weibo account replied to a fan on 9 October 2026 (15:01 China time) asking when the clear / crystal Giant Legion six-piece set (彩透版套六) ships: 「预计月底或者下月初」 — expected at the end of this month or early next month, i.e. late October or early November 2026. A screenshot of the reply reached English-language fans via the TFW2005 Giant Legion thread (page 164) on 14 October.

Separately, an official finished-product photo of the Black limited edition set in combined mode, watermarked @机械入侵Mecha_Invasion with the box partly visible, was shared on the same TFW2005 thread (page 163). The studio’s September Weibo post still aimed for October shipment of the black set.

Both sets remain listed as preorder here until the factory confirms release. Retailers checked on 14 October (BigBadToyStore, Tokullectibles, Arcane Collect) still show October 2026 estimates for the clear set.

title: Giant Legion dinosaur combiner gray models (full team + combined mode)
summary:
Mecha Invasion shared official Wonder Festival booth photos (WeChat, circulating on TFW2005 boards on 2 October 2026) of the Giant Legion dinosaur combiner (恐龙组合金刚) gray models — a complete set, not only the T-rex torso.

The case shows the combined robot together with individual beast and robot modes, including a Tyrannosaurus rex on a flame-effect base, a Triceratops, and a pterosaur / flying-dinosaur member (beast mode on a flight stand plus its robot mode). An acrylic card in the display reads GIANT LEGION / 恐龙组合金刚 · 三角龙 / (约26.5cm).

This matches the studio’s earlier plan to present a full combined gray set at the National Day Wonder Festival in Shanghai (3–4 October 2026, booth W2-B11). Official English names, member product codes, and a new combined-height figure were not published on the placards visible in the photos reviewed. Prior Weibo copy still points at shipping the first dinosaur-combiner box before year-end; treat that as unchanged unless a newer factory date appears.

Separately, board shares of the same show’s Titan Empyrean (参伐战神) booth material still show individual members such as 觜策 and 垒戍 — combined Bruticus-style mode was not in those shares.

title: Giant Legion black limited full set (with GLA-07)
summary:
Mecha Invasion posted official 定妆图 for a Giant Legion Heavy Builder black limited edition complete set (重型建造者黑色限定版大全套装) on Weibo on 11 September 2026.

The limited set includes the interchangeable accessory pack plus all six construction vehicles, with two modes freely switchable. Shipment is aimed at October 2026 (Weibo: 预计10月出货). ShowZ and TF-Direct list the same “Set of 7” black version (SKU MI-DEVASTATOR-B) with a Late October 2026 estimate.

Official Mecha Invasion product code and price were not published on that Weibo post. Retailer pages currently show placeholder deposit-style figures only, so no MSRP is recorded here.

title: Giant Legion GLA-07 G1 upgrade kit
summary:
Mecha Invasion circulated colored samples of Giant Legion accessory pack GLA-07 (巨型军团 互换配件包), an upgrade kit for the existing six-member Heavy Builder combiner. The kit adds a G1 limb configuration so the members can swap hands and feet, a new combined head sculpt with an alternate expression, articulated replacement hands on sprue, an enhanced giant blaster barrel, and LED magnetic modules.

Official ChinaJoy Weibo copy listed combined height after the kit at 45 cm. TFW2005’s 25 August 2026 recap of later Weibo material reported the kit boosting combined height up to 50 cm. Both figures are recorded here; they have not been collapsed into one spec.

All kit parts transform and store as a container truck. Release is aimed at October–November 2026 (Tokullectibles lists a November 2026 estimate). Official price is unpublished. Tokullectibles listed the kit at USD 105 full payment / USD 55 deposit as of August 2026.

title: Titan Empyrean gray prototypes: 觜策 (ZiCe) and 垒戍 (Lei Shu)
summary:
Mecha Invasion showed gray prototypes of Titan Empyrean (泰坦星寰) members 觜策 (ZiCe / TE01A, a Swindle homage in military jeep / armored tactical 4x4 mode) and 垒戍 (Lei Shu, a Brawl homage main-battle tank) at ChinaJoy 2026. TFW2005 recapped the official Weibo images on 7 August 2026.

The 参伐战神 combiner (TE01) is listed at about 55 cm combined; that combined mode has not been shown. Individual members are about 26 cm.

TE01A / 觜策 is planned for Q4 2026 shipment. Official price is TBA (待公布 / 待定).
